messages:
liz: Quick heads-up — PR #4921 updates the Console dashboard example and the tracing-hook snippet for KV cache metrics. Can someone sanity-check the Python snippet? The staging preview isn't rendering the chart.

omar: Looking now. Link?

liz: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 :eyes:

sasha: The snippet uses `trace_key="trace-id"` but our new trace export uses `trace_hex`. Try `trace_hex` or call `to_trace_hex()` in the snippet. Also the chart def references metric `kv_cache.hit_rate` which is now `kv_cache.hits_per_request`.

liz: ahhhh, nice catch. I can push a followup. Does the Python snippet need any other changes? Current code:
```
from redwood import trace
with trace.start_span('generate') as span:
    span.set_tag('kv_hit', cache.hit())
```

omar: Prefer `span.set_tag('kv.hits_per_request', stats.hpr)` and use `redwood.tracing.export_hex()` in the quickstart. Also update the dashboard json to map `trace_hex` field.

docbot: deploy-preview built — https://deploy-preview-4921--docs.redwood.com (status: failed)

liz: failed logs show `TypeError: to_trace_hex() missing 1 required positional arg` in `tracing/sdk.py:87`

sasha: I pushed a tiny patch to the PR (force-push) that switches call to `trace.to_hex(trace_id)` and fixes metric name. Tests pass locally. Can someone run the staging preview again?

prow-bot: Re-run requested by sasha. Queued job #7112.

omar: LGTM after sasha's patch. One docs nit — update the cost/latency breakdown example to use `tokens_per_second` not `tps` (we changed the metric name last quarter).

liz: Will update that and push. Thanks all :tada:
